about: Cross-implementor cases for the AP2 PQC v1 signed input (algovoi-side/README.md 'v1 signed input'), generated by an independent JavaScript implementation (pqam interop/ap2-pq-conformance/ap2pqc-v1.mjs). Every case was checked by that implementation before writing. Test keys only.

seed_material.derivation: ES256 / Ed25519: private_key = sha256(seed) (AlgoVoi's v1 derivation). ML-DSA-65: FIPS 204 keygen with xi = sha256(seed); pure, empty context, deterministic signing (rnd = 0).
